findings.detail: After generation invocation, terminal persistence failure, missing terminal or workers_settled:false bypass mandatory local transport settlement. Settlement must run independently of terminal validation/persistence; preserve cleanup and primary errors, and suppress scoring on either failure.
findings.evidence: Synthetic generate returns null: settle invocations=0; source also shows persistence in finally throwing past settlement.

findings.detail: Cancellation during scoring is observed but never rechecked before success. Synthetic score aborts caller then returns development pass; launcher returns status scored, caller-cancelled and development_target_passed true. Recheck cancellation before success and retain scoring evidence without claiming completed supervisor success.

limitations: Candidate callbacks are synthetic; production qualification, local HTTP settlement, combined capacity and outer deadlines remain unreviewed launch prerequisites.
